description: Export your full library (saved tracks, albums, shows, episodes, audiobooks) to a local directory as JSON or CSV sidecar files. Respects SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP per type; when capped, reports cap_reached + truncated and a prose footer ("first N of … — raise SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP").

format.description: Output format: json (single file) or csv (one file per type)

output_dir.description: Local directory to write into, confined to the output root (default ~/.spotify-mcp/portability, set SPOTIFY_MCP_PORTABILITY_DIR to move it)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: export_library_json
